title: The box was taped shut from the inside
description:
We moved into a smaller house with low ceilings, and Mum hasn't laughed since the old one sold. The moving boxes are still stacked by the door. One of them has a frown drawn on it in black marker.

Every morning there are fewer boxes in the stack, and something in the house is a little taller.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Would you have peeled the tape on that bottom box?
